purpose: Recover the weak TARGET-061 screenshot QA with a stricter read-only probe that verifies page title, heading, grid headers and role/aria signals before accepting a setup page as book-usable evidence.
whyNow: TARGET-062 classified TARGET-061 as useful but too weak for final routing: some accepted/rejected decisions relied on generic text such as Kreditoren, Neu and Beschreibung, and compact text included platform configuration strings. The next run must improve screenshot truth before any setup write gate.
acceptanceCriteria: No page is accepted from generic text alone.
Each accepted screenshot has at least two page-specific signals beyond New/Neu, Code and Beschreibung.
Platform config strings such as trustedOriginAuthorities are filtered from text evidence.
Any page that cannot be proven is rejected with exact missing signals.
No setup write, master data, draft, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut occurs.
stopIf: The browser is outside playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
A dialog asks for OK, Yes, Ja, New, Edit, Delete, Apply, Preview Posting or Post.
The route requires typing a setup value or confirming a change.
The screenshot QA cannot identify page-specific signals after direct route and safe layout inspection.
